name: git checkout
purpose: Switch to an existing branch, or create and switch to a new branch with `-b`.
explanation: Moves `HEAD` to the specified branch so new commits are recorded there. Passing `-b` creates the branch and switches to it in one command.

parameters.description: Creates `<newBranch>` and immediately switches `HEAD` to it.

whenToUse: Before starting new feature work so `main` stays clean.
commonMistakes: Forgetting `-b` when the branch does not exist yet.
commonErrors: error: pathspec 'feature-login' did not match any file(s) known to git
